limits: Saved physics states round-trip exactly; freshly recomputed end-effector positions can differ from cached recorded sensor observations and their deltas are retained. States are pre-action, so the final success-producing transition is absent. Predicate diagnostics do not replace recorded outcomes. Contact-based grasp checks are descriptive, not proof of an intentional or stable grasp. Selection illustrates failures and does not estimate prevalence.
scope: 12 selected clean trajectories, every 10th recorded policy state plus final recorded state; no policy inference or new rollouts.
